name: regimeshift_active_loans
description: Free — no payment required. All currently-active loans with their current Chainlink-priced LTV, liquidatable or not — useful for lender position monitoring.

name: regimeshift_asset_asset_vrp
description:
Returns the current Volatility Risk Premium (VRP) for {asset} (ETH or BTC), expressed as Deribit DVOL (annualised implied vol from options) minus the 72-hour Parkinson realised volatility estimator. Positive VRP = implied vol overpriced relative to realised = sell-vol opportunity (premium-collection edge). Negative VRP = implied underpriced = buy-vol opportunity (gamma-long edge). Response includes regime classification (LOW / MID / HIGH), full input audit trail (DVOL, RV_72h, RV_6h, spot price, timestamp, source), and the open methodology URL for verification.

Use cases:
  - Position-size delta-neutral vol-selling strategies (short straddles, strangles)
  - Time entry into options spreads when premium is rich or compressed
  - Compare cross-asset VRP (ETH vs BTC) for relative-value vol trades
  - Combine with Agent-SOFR carry for total expected return modeling
  - Build vol-regime triggers for systematic agent strategies
  - Benchmark options market-makers' fair value vs realised

Keywords: volatility risk premium, VRP, DVOL, Deribit volatility index, Parkinson realized volatility, implied vs realized vol, vol carry, vol surface, sell-vol signal, buy-vol signal, ETH vol, BTC vol, crypto options carry, agent vol oracle, x402 paid vol data, vol regime classifier, on-chain vol oracle, delta-neutral, gamma-long, options premium. Price: $0.001 per call (vendor spec).

name: regimeshift_help
description: Read RegimeShift's API quickstart, fetched on demand and cached for this process. The guide includes escrow and intent workflows; it does not authorize wallet operations. Treazury handles payment. SSE streaming is not supported; use the JSON response mode for intent matching.

name: regimeshift_intent_borrow
description: Free — no payment required. Submit a borrower intent (wallet, USDC principal wanted vs WETH collateral, max rate, max duration); matching runs synchronously and returns a match payload when a compatible lender is found.

wallet.description: EVM address of the borrower wallet — must hold the collateral + approve V4 to pull it

principal_asset.description: Asset borrower wants to receive (USDC only in v1)

principal_amount.description: Principal amount to borrow in USDC

collateral_amount_max.description: Maximum WETH the borrower is willing to lock as collateral. Matcher will lock the MINIMUM amount the live regime requires (e.g. ~88% LTV in LOW regime, ~55% LTV in EXTREME) — your max is the ceiling, not the target.

max_rate_bps.description: Maximum acceptable rate in basis points (1% = 100 bps)

webhook_url.description: (optional) Server POSTs full signed-quote payload to this URL within ~1s of match

name: regimeshift_intent_intent_id_match
description: Free — no payment required. Long-poll for a match on an open intent: holds the connection up to wait seconds (max 300) and returns immediately when a match is found, otherwise a timeout packet — re-poll on timeout. Run this server with --timeout 320 so the long poll survives. stream=true (newline-delimited JSON) is not usable through MCP — leave it false.

wait.title: Wait
wait.description: Seconds to hold the connection waiting for a match (up to 300).

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Ignore — ndjson streaming is not usable through MCP; leave false.

name: regimeshift_intent_intent_id_matches
description: Free — no payment required. All matches for an intent plus its fill status (the sweep view): every match behind a partially-filled lender intent, each with the full signed quote payload, plus filled vs remaining capacity.

name: regimeshift_intent_lend
description: Free — no payment required. Submit a lender intent to the order book (wallet, USDC amount, min rate, max duration); matching runs synchronously on each new intent and a matched quote payload becomes available via regimeshift_matches_recent.

wallet.description: EVM address (checksum or lowercase) of the lender wallet that will fund the loan principal on-chain

amount.description: Principal amount to lend, in USDC (e.g. 50.0 = $50)

max_duration_sec.description: Maximum loan duration the lender will commit to (120s - 24h)

min_rate_bps.description: Minimum acceptable rate in basis points (1% = 100 bps)

max_default_prob.description: Maximum acceptable default probability — caps max-LTV regime, lower = safer collateral demand

webhook_url.description: (optional) Server POSTs full signed-quote payload to this URL within ~1s of match. Best-effort, no retries. Handler must be idempotent on match_id.

name: regimeshift_intents_open
description: Free — no payment required. All currently-open intents from both sides — the live order book. Matching requires overlap on duration first (borrower's needed term ≤ lender's max), then rate, then amount + collateral fit.

name: regimeshift_liquidatable_loans
description: Free — no payment required. Active loans with on-chain LTV ≥ 95% whose grace period has passed — anyone can call InterAgentRepoV4.liquidate(loanId) for the 3% bounty. Read-only; does not execute liquidations.

name: regimeshift_loans_registry
description: Free — no payment required. Full lifecycle of every V4 loan reconstructed from on-chain event logs: the last limit originated loans (~14h lookback, 30s cache) with status, counterparties, principal/collateral, rate, LTV and originate/close tx hashes.

name: regimeshift_matches_recent
description: Free — no payment required. Recent matches with full signed-quote payloads (EIP-712 signature, rate decomposition, contract address) ready for on-chain originate().

name: regimeshift_rate_sofr_usd
description:
Returns the current Agent-SOFR rate: a manipulation-resistant, decentralized USD short-rate benchmark for inter-agent capital markets on Base mainnet. Aggregates 7 sources via weighted median (Deribit options put-call parity, Hyperliquid PERP funding, Aevo options PCP, Deribit futures basis 3-month, Aave V3 Base USDC borrow, Compound Base USDC borrow, NY Fed SOFR 30-day macro anchor), then adds a variance premium derived from Barndorff-Nielsen–Shephard jump decomposition (lambda=1.097 closed-form on 444k 5-min ETH/USDC bars, ~4.2 years) and a 6-mode regime premium.

Use cases:
  - Price short-term inter-agent loans against a transparent benchmark rate
  - Derive carry costs for delta-neutral perp/spot strategies
  - Anchor variance-aware collateral haircuts (the max-LTV endpoint depends on this)
  - Replace centralized rate oracles for agent-native applications
  - Build agent-economy interest rate derivatives (rate swaps, caps, floors)

Keywords: agent SOFR, agent-native benchmark, decentralized short rate, USD short rate oracle, agent capital market, inter-agent lending, x402 paid rate, Base mainnet rate, BNS jump decomposition, variance premium, regime classifier, weighted-median rate aggregation, IPFS-pinned methodology, on-chain rate benchmark, money market rate, risk-free rate proxy, USD interest rate. Price: $0.001 per call (vendor spec).

name: regimeshift_risk_max_ltv
description:
Returns the maximum safe loan-to-value (LTV) ratio for a collateralized x402 / RFQ agent loan on Base mainnet. Computes the smaller of two bounds:
  1. math_max_ltv — Black-Cox first-passage bound from (cv + lambda·j²)-derived      variance over the loan horizon, capped by the lender's max_default_prob
  2. regime_cap_ltv — hard cap from the 6-mode volatility regime classifier      (LOW/RESTING ~92% → EXTREME/BLOWOFF ~55%)

Response includes `binding_constraint` so agents see WHY the cap is what it is (math vs regime_cap) — useful for adaptive collateral strategies. Same calibrator as Agent-SOFR (BNS jump decomposition, 444k 5-min ETH/USDC bars, lambda=1.097).

Use cases:
  - Sizing the `collateral_amount_max` parameter in /v1/intent/borrow
  - Stress-test existing collateralized lending positions before vol spikes
  - Build LTV-aware risk dashboards for agent treasuries
  - Derive auto-rebalance / margin-add triggers when LTV approaches cap
  - Compare collateral efficiency across volatility regimes for capital allocation

Keywords: max LTV, loan to value, collateralized lending, variance-aware risk, regime-aware lending, Black-Cox default model, max default probability, lender risk parameter, agent loan terms, BNS variance, on-chain risk oracle, collateral haircut, liquidation threshold, agent collateral sizing. Price: $0.001 per call (vendor spec).
